description: Purpose: rCB grade selector - take measured carbon-black parameters (iodine adsorption, DBP, BET, ash) or a target native grade, and return the closest grade, the rCB tier, the recommended substitution ratio for the application segment, and the MUST-TEST list. Guidelines: use for "can this rCB replace N550 / what grade is this / how much can I substitute" questions; supply ash whenever possible because ash is the single most discriminating parameter between rCB and virgin carbon black. Limits: parameters are RANGES not exact values, substitution ratios come from public sources and business judgment and are NOT guarantees, and the tool never returns formulations, process parameters or customer data. Ex: select_rcb_grade(iodine=40, dbp=118, ash=6), select_rcb_grade(target_grade='N550', application='foam').

application.description: 用途段；决定建议替代比例

ash.description: 灰分（%），ASTM D1506（强烈建议提供，用于判 rCB 档位）

bet.description: BET 比表面积（m²/g），ASTM D6556（可选）

name: select_rcb_grade

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
